executive_summary: Northstar Community Gardens should focus on converting orientation interest into a clearly scheduled first shift. A common beginner pathway, named shift hosts, and a small measurement loop can improve conversion without adding paid software or staff.

current_situation.summary: The fictional network attracts volunteers but loses momentum between orientation and the first practical shift. Local variation and unclear beginner options increase friction for volunteers and garden leads.
evidence: The synthetic orientation-to-first-shift conversion is 35% (42 of 120).
Synthetic interviews indicate uncertainty about beginner-friendly shifts.
Five fictional gardens currently coordinate onboarding independently.

objectives.statement: Raise the synthetic orientation-to-first-shift conversion rate from 35% to at least 60%.
Adopt one minimum onboarding pathway across all five fictional gardens.
Reduce routine onboarding coordination effort for garden leads.

strategic_choices.choice: Prioritize the first completed shift as the main onboarding outcome.
strategic_choices.rationale: It is the clearest observable step between initial interest and active volunteering.
strategic_choices.trade_offs: Other engagement activities receive less attention during the initial six-month pilot.

strategic_choices.choice: Standardize a minimum pathway while allowing gardens to retain local details.
strategic_choices.rationale: A common core reduces confusion without removing useful local flexibility.
strategic_choices.trade_offs: Garden leads must align on a small set of shared practices.

recommended_initiatives.name: Beginner shift pathway
recommended_initiatives.description: Publish a mobile-friendly list of recurring beginner shifts and let each oriented volunteer select one before leaving orientation.

recommended_initiatives.name: Named first-shift hosts
recommended_initiatives.description: Assign a trained fictional host to welcome beginners at each listed shift and use a short common checklist.

recommended_initiatives.name: Monthly conversion review
recommended_initiatives.description: Review a minimal synthetic funnel by garden and resolve the largest point of volunteer drop-off.

risks: Volunteer hosts may be unavailable for some weekend shifts.
Local variation may weaken adoption of the common pathway.
Synthetic tracking may be incomplete during the pilot.
assumptions: The fictional gardens can publish a shared mobile-friendly schedule using existing tools.
At least one volunteer host can be identified per garden.
Completing a first shift is a useful early indicator of continued participation.

success_measures.measure: Gardens using the minimum onboarding pathway
Median days from orientation to first shift

next_steps.action: Agree on the definition of a completed first shift and the synthetic baseline.
Design the minimum beginner pathway with representatives from the five fictional gardens.
Run a two-garden synthetic pilot before network-wide adoption.
